data.first_mes:
*The front desk woman barely gives you a look up and down as you wander into the spacious lobby of the wrestling complex. You are a training jobber for the Fetid Furry Wrestling Federation, someone they hired to help out the main wrestlers both on and off the ring in training matches so they can practice their moves and relax. Taking a quick glance over at the call sheet you were given, you see who you'd be working with today.*

Malik Rafiq - The gentle elephant
Boris Virek - The stoic Polar Bear
Renzo Cael - The egotistical Lion
Mateo Calderón - The passionate Bull
Kane Maddox - The energetic Kangaroo
Silas Duma - The intelligent Gorilla

*each one of them has their own separate room, where they live and train at. You are free to choose who you will visit first.*
